name: o-json: navigate the shape and viewer

actions.label: Quit a clean viewer
actions.caption: ctrl+c quits this clean viewer. Use it when you have finished reading and have no unwritten edits.

actions.label: Quit without a write
actions.caption: i J makes an edit first; Q quits without asking to write it. Use this deliberately when you want to abandon the edited buffer.

actions.label: See the generated jq
actions.caption: g j opens the jq panel. Inspect the program that describes the current structure before applying it elsewhere.

actions.label: Copy an inner key
actions.caption: y i k copies the selected key without its value. Reuse the field name while writing another structure.

actions.label: Copy an inner path
actions.caption: y i p copies the selected path. Use it as the precise starting point for another query.

actions.label: Copy a structure subtree
actions.caption: y i s copies the selected subtree. Keep its complete structure together for reuse.

actions.label: Copy the selected values
actions.caption: y i v copies the values under items. Take the collection itself rather than its path or field name.

actions.label: Extend a pending count
actions.caption: Move into data, then y 1 2 j copies up to 12 rows. Appending digits builds a count; copying stops at the end of this small sample.

actions.label: Append zero to a count
actions.caption: Move into data, then y 2 0 j requests 20 rows, stopping at the end of this sample. A zero after a digit extends the count.

actions.label: Move to the other pane
actions.caption: ctrl+a o moves focus to the data pane. Read the actual values for the shape you selected.

actions.label: Return to the preceding pane
actions.caption: ctrl+a o moves into data; ctrl+w W returns to the previous focus stop. Use the reverse window motion to retrace your focus.

actions.label: Cancel an incomplete nesting chord
actions.caption: < starts the outdent chord; esc cancels it before it acts. Use this when you begin a nesting command and decide to keep the structure.

actions.label: Fit the outline columns
actions.caption: z > widens a column first; z F fits the columns back to their content. Recover readable widths after a manual adjustment.

actions.label: Go to the document root
actions.caption: g g selects the first outline row. Start again at the whole document after exploring a nested branch.

actions.label: Go to the last field
actions.caption: G selects the last visible outline row. Reach the end of a large shape without repeated movement.

actions.label: Mark rows in the original tree
actions.caption: T switches to the original tree; 2 space marks a range. Keep a small set of outline rows selected for an operation.

actions.label: Move up the outline
actions.caption: k moves up one visible line. Return to the field immediately above your selection.

actions.label: Move down the outline
actions.caption: j moves down one visible line. Follow the shape before choosing which values to inspect.

actions.label: Move up half a page
actions.caption: G reaches the end first; ctrl+u moves half a screen back up. Revisit fields just above the current window.

actions.label: Move back a page
actions.caption: G reaches the end first; ctrl+b moves one screen back. Compare a later branch with the fields above it.

actions.label: Move down half a page
actions.caption: ctrl+d moves half a screen down the outline. Scan a large shape while keeping some context in view.

actions.label: Move down a page
actions.caption: ctrl+f advances one screen through the outline. Use it to cover more of a large document quickly.

actions.label: Copy the displayed row
actions.caption: Y copies the current outline row as text. Keep the displayed shape information in your notes.

actions.label: Begin a jq operation
actions.caption: ! starts a jq operation and waits for its object. Build the query from the part of JSON you are already pointing at.

actions.label: Begin a change operation
actions.caption: i enters EDIT first; c starts a change operation. Select the key to rename instead of changing an unrelated value.

actions.label: Begin a delete operation
actions.caption: i enters EDIT first; d starts a delete operation. Choose its object next so you remove exactly the intended structure.

actions.label: Begin a copy operation
actions.caption: y starts a copy operation and waits for its object. Choose a key, path or value next instead of memorizing a separate command for each.

actions.label: Choose an around object
actions.caption: y a chooses the around form of a copy object. Include its surrounding key or generalized path when that context matters.

actions.label: Choose an inner object
actions.caption: y i narrows the copy operation to an inner object. The next letter chooses a value, key, path or subtree.

actions.label: Cancel a pending operation
actions.caption: y begins a copy operation; esc cancels it. Return to movement when you change your mind before choosing an object.

actions.label: Collapse the selected branch
actions.caption: h collapses items. Keep its siblings visible while temporarily hiding the fields inside it.

actions.label: Expand a branch again
actions.caption: h closes items first; l expands it again. Reveal its fields when you are ready to inspect the collection.

actions.label: Move a field up
actions.caption: i enters EDIT; K moves items up among its siblings. Put the important fields earlier in the output.

actions.label: Move a field down
actions.caption: i enters EDIT; J moves items down among its siblings. Reorder fields without rewriting their values.

actions.label: Focus on one subtree
actions.caption: z + zooms the outline into items. Set aside unrelated fields while understanding this collection.

actions.label: Show the surrounding tree
actions.caption: z + zooms into items first; z - brings its parent context back. See where the collection belongs in the document.

actions.label: Reset the outline zoom
actions.caption: z + narrows the outline first; z 0 restores the full tree. Return to a familiar overview after drilling in.

actions.label: Give the structure the window
actions.caption: ctrl+w o shows only the focused structure pane. Use the full width for long paths and type information.

actions.label: Restore both panes
actions.caption: ctrl+w o shows the structure alone first; press it again to restore both panes. Return to reading shape and values together.

actions.label: Copy into a named register
actions.caption: " a selects register a; y i p copies the selected path there. Keep a useful path while later copies use the unnamed register.

actions.label: Enter EDIT deliberately
actions.caption: i enters EDIT on the structure. The badge and available keys change so you can reshape the buffer deliberately.

actions.label: Reload the source file
actions.caption: i r temporarily renames items; leave EDIT, then R reloads the source and y confirms discarding that edit. Recover the saved JSON when you want to start over.

actions.label: Choose a mode by name
actions.caption: g m opens the mode picker. Read the available modes and their purposes when you do not remember an entry key.

actions.label: Recognize the edit gate
actions.caption: p on the structure asks you to press i first. The message explains why a put needs EDIT before changing the buffer.

actions.label: Choose another document
actions.caption: e opens the file chooser. Select another document while keeping the current one until a choice is made.

actions.label: Focus the structure pane
actions.caption: ctrl+w l enters data; ctrl+w h returns to the structure pane. Move left without changing the selected JSON path.

actions.label: Focus the data pane
actions.caption: ctrl+w l focuses the pane on the right. Keep the shape selected while moving into its table.

actions.label: Open JSON from the clipboard
actions.caption: T shows the original tree; p loads our sample clipboard JSON. Inspect a copied response without creating a source file.

actions.label: Edit the raw JSON
actions.caption: g r opens RAW in the configured editor. This lesson returns edited JSON, so you can see the buffer update while the source stays unwritten.

actions.label: Read another data view
actions.caption: D changes the selected collection from table to FLAT. Read each value beside its path when a table hides nesting.

actions.label: Cycle views backward
actions.caption: shift+tab cycles the data view backward. Reach the previous representation without stepping through all the others.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
